## Où j'en suis
`cmd/replay` is written and tested (commits 4e2d9b7, f13a06c) with dry-run, per-partition ordering, a rejects file and a topic allowlist (`events.replay.v3` only). The dry run on the 12/11 window (14:10–17:40 UTC) reported 18,442,107 events to replay and 3,118 schema v2 lines rejected. PR #233 is open, awaiting Daniel's review; the real replay has not been run.

- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/ingest#233 is open, waiting for Daniel's review.
- [prochaine-étape] After review, run the real replay into `events.replay.v3`, then the aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12.
- [prochaine-étape] Give Rachel the ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly (due Friday) once Daniel has reviewed.
- [essai-raté] Dry run with `--batch 50000` was OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit; `--batch 5000` worked (310 MiB peak).
- [essai-raté] The 4-worker read broke per-partition order; fixed by assigning each partition to one worker.
- [décision] Replay everything (no age cutoff) into `events.replay.v3`, never into `events.v3` directly. (source: t05)
- [décision] Keep the job memory limit unchanged and use batch 5k; the namespace quota is capped. (source: t13)
